verdict.rationale: Polar documents no-code Checkout Links that redirect customers to a hosted, configurable checkout page ('Configure once in the dashboard, share the URL anywhere... Polar handles the rest'), alongside embedded and API-driven alternatives for deeper integration, plus a sandbox to test the full funnel. This directly matches redirecting to a vendor-hosted checkout without building custom payment UI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of conversion optimization claims or real-world merchant testimonials on checkout performance.
